cards.quote: Drag depends on the density of the air, the square of the velocity, the air’s viscosity and compressibility

cards.hint: It shortens shape and flow effects to one symbol
cards.quote: drag D is equal to the drag coefficient Cd times the density rho (ρ)
cards.stem: What single variable collects complex effects in the drag law

cards.quote: The drag coefficient given above includes form drag, skin friction drag, wave drag, and induced drag components.
